login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Rotation planning for apprentices
login.hint: Access is managed through Microsoft Entra ID. After your first sign-in, an admin assigns you to the right locations.

errors.unauthorized: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
errors.forbidden: You don't have permission to do that.
errors.sso_denied: Sign-in was rejected by the identity provider.
errors.sso_unavailable: The sign-in service is currently unavailable.
errors.login_expired: The sign-in attempt expired. Please sign in again.
errors.oauth_invalid_request: The request from the program is invalid.
errors.oauth_invalid_redirect: The program's redirect address is not registered.
errors.oauth_invalid_resource: The program asks for access to a different service than this one.
errors.reauth_required: Please sign in again to allow access.

accessHint.read: View and analyse data. Nothing is changed.
accessHint.write: Also change data, as far as your permissions allow.

assistants.title: AI assistants
assistants.intro: Connect Claude Code to {app} to ask questions about the data or have tasks done. The assistant works on your behalf and never has more permissions than you.

connect.title: Connect Claude Code
connect.description: Set it up once, then sign in from Claude Code.
connect.step1: Run this command in your terminal:
connect.step2: In Claude Code, open {command}, select the server {server}, then choose “Authenticate”.
connect.step3: Confirm in the browser what the assistant may do.
connect.lifetime: A connection ends at the latest 12 hours after you signed in to this application – just like the sign-in itself. After that, open {command} in Claude Code again and choose “Authenticate”.

privacy.title: Data protection
privacy.text: What the assistant reads is sent to the AI provider. Only use assistants your company has approved, and only retrieve data you are allowed to process there.

connections.title: Your connections
connections.description: Programs that may access {app} on your behalf.
connections.emptyHint: As soon as you allow a program, it appears here.
connections.disconnectQuestion: {name} loses access immediately. You can connect the program again at any time.

consent.title: Allow access?
consent.intro: A program wants to connect to {app} and work on your behalf. It never has more permissions than you.
consent.clientHint: The name is declared by the program itself and not verified.
consent.redirectHint: After your decision, the browser jumps to this address.
consent.requested: The program asked for “{level}”. The lowest level is always preselected.
consent.footer: You can disconnect at any time under “AI assistants”. It ends by itself at the latest 12 hours after you signed in.
consent.errorHint: Nothing was granted. Start the sign-in again in the program.
